reviews.title: Crashes mid session and won’t let me log in without paying
reviews.text:
I’m a longtime Peloton user with a years-long, active All-Access Membership. I have a Peloton Bike, so Breathwrk is supposed to be included with my membership.

Everything was fine until I finished a session. The app crashed, logged me out, and then apparently decided that my years-long Peloton membership no longer exists. When I tried to log back in, I was told I didn’t have a membership and was prompted to PAY for one.

I do, in fact, have a membership. It is active. It has been active for YEARS. I am not hallucinating my Peloton Bike.

I tried contacting support, but instead of connecting me with a human being, I was trapped in an endless conversation with an AI bot that refused to let me speak to an actual representative. Which is especially ironic for an app whose entire purpose is supposedly helping people manage stress.

10/10 for irony. 0/10 for actually helping me breathe. Please fix the membership issue and let customers talk to a human when your app locks them out of a service they already pay for.

reviews.title: love the app but it stopped working for me
reviews.text: I really love the app and am excited to do some of the guided programs, but the start button is unresponsive. Hoping a fox can happen quickly!

reviews.title: How hard is it to get this app to just open?
reviews.text: I’ve use this app for well over a year all of a sudden it gives you continued to sign in prompts and then when you sign in using your Apple ID, it just closes.  I purchased a subscription and it’s not working at all.  Developers - do your job.

reviews.title: good but needs more free options/variety
reviews.text: i love doing breathwork, i have chronic anxiety and i always just need more air cause i feel like i never have enough! this app is great but i wish it was a little bit smoother in the aspect of a fair share of variety and options for subscription free.

reviews.title: App stopped working, no support
reviews.text: Initially I really loved this app! Great prompts and high quality content. However after a few weeks I am not able to access videos, and have reached out several times to support for help without any responses. Loved it when it was working but disappointed to spend money on something that stopped working.

reviews.text: I love the app but it’s been so buggy the last few months. Everytime I select the dailies the play button doesn’t work. This is my favorite feature and I can’t even use it. Did not get fixed with the recent update.

reviews.title: Ok, but missing some key features
reviews.text: It’s ok and right now I prefer to do the meditation classes in the peloton app instead. I would use this more if they added in heart rate monitor so I could see how the sessions influence my heart rate.

reviews.title: Peloton has ruined this app

reviews.title: continuous sign in requests
reviews.text: It’s horrible. Since this app was purchased by Peloton, I am asked if I am a Peloton member every SINGLE day. It’s just ridiculous. Who has time for that?!

reviews.title: Miss the old version
reviews.text: Got a new phone and had to download this. So sad to see how the design and usability are lacking when compared to the old version. Missing features, missing the color coded sections, missing favorites, UI not as easy to navigate, etc. I wish I had the choice to revert to the old version. You should offer it as an alternative! Call it Classic Breathwrk for those who miss the old version.

reviews.title: Constantly getting logged out
reviews.text: Anyone else have issue with constantly getting logged out after every 2-3 session? Started about 6 weeks ago. Submitted in app feedback and bug everytime it happens.

reviews.title: Love it
reviews.text: Just needs an ascetically pleasing streak widget. Something compatible with IOS, like Bends widget

reviews.title: Very basic
reviews.text: The context is super basic. The info says it has extended breath holds but it doesn’t. So if you’re looking for guided box breathing and such this will be helpful otherwise it’s a waste.

reviews.title: It’s not free
reviews.text:
Only reason why I gave it a 2 star is because it started my journey into HRV and LHR exercises. Thankful, but…

I’m never this type of person, positivity is essential but extremely disappointed. I was a solid 9 months in a streak, then got hit with the app becoming entirely paid / subscription based. 

All my progress tracked within this app, gone. Then I get hit with an ad and check it out again, can only do one exercise that I can’t even change the duration for. 

Jokes, especially when they make you do a test to see how optimal your lung capacity is and give you basic exercises. 

Thankful I found a new app.

reviews.title: Pay 50 for an app that doesn’t listen
reviews.text: When you adjust the timer to do something like a stretching exercise the timer will just do whatever it wants. So if you want to do a minute long exercise be prepared for it to go on longer to 2 sometimes 4 minutes. You’d think something as basic as a timer could be bug free but I digress.

reviews.title: Not accessibility friendly
reviews.text: My Dr recommended this app to help engage my parasympathetic system and learn how to do diaphragmatic breathing. However, I couldn’t find a beginner program that could help me get build basic capacity.  The search terms for what I needed had timers that were way too long for my capabilities.  I felt anxious and disappointed that I app focused on breathing is not set up to help people who might actually benefit.

reviews.title: Why so glitchy?
reviews.text: This app could be great and a real value-add for Peloton subscribers, but I have so many problems with it not working or logging me out as soon as I finish a session. I hope these issues can be fixed. I want to use this app more, but it’s frustrating now.

reviews.title: Good app locked behind subscription and crammed with junk
reviews.text: I've been using this app for a while and I really liked it at the start. It was simple, focused on great breathing techniques that you could schedule. Well a lot of that is gone behind an expensive pay wall and they're cramming the app with generic meditations and classes you can find anywhere.

reviews.title: This app sucks
reviews.text: I paid for this app annually via Apple. It can only be used on one device. There is no login or password feature. The app doesn’t work on iPad because its sizing is incorrect. Contacting them for support is useless.

reviews.title: Start button doesn’t work
reviews.text: I can’t play the meditations. Start button doesn’t work.

reviews.title: Glitchy App
reviews.text: I get signed out every time I complete a session

reviews.title: Refund request
reviews.text:
0 stars, I signed up for a 7 day free trial and was charged for a year subscription with no easy way to cancel. I had to speak with an apple support rep who is submitting a refund request. A lot of hassle and so unnecessary. I did not consent to have my credit card charged and now going through a lot
to get a refund. Breathwrk is slimy and would not recommend.

reviews.title: Very buggy
reviews.text: Love the breath work and meditation aspects. I hate how buggy this app is. It logs you out after every session, has ux issues like overlaying critical buttons so you can’t click them, and generally lacks the polish I’d expect from a company like peloton.

reviews.title: Changing Duration Issues
reviews.text: Is there a way to change the time duration on the breathwork sessions? The app freezes every time I attempt to change the number of minutes.

reviews.title: used to love this app :(
reviews.text: i used to love this app but you can’t do anything without paying anymore. it’s sad.

reviews.title: Can’t sign in with Peloton
reviews.text: I have tried for a couple of weeks, installing and deleting the app to see if it works, but it just doesn’t work… It keeps loading and loading if you pick to use your peloton account. Other Peloton’s apps are great, simple and work great… but this one, next time, before you promote it, email or ask peloton people to use anything, make sure we can actually log in and use it.

reviews.title: Again
reviews.text: Why is it that whenever you do an update you mess things up.

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: When signing up the plan I had chose offered a 7 day free trial. I tried it out for an hour before I decided I wasn’t a fan. They had immediately charged me. I reached out to Apple and they saw that the trial wasn’t even initiated. I then reached out to the developers at which point they didn’t even acknowledge the charge and basically told me I’m SOL. Would not download this app unless you want to lose $50 right off the bat and be scammed.

reviews.title: Loved the app initially
reviews.text:
I loved the simplicity of this app and the ability to create my own breathing experience. 
I’ve recommended it to friends multiple times. Not sure what has happened but it no longer recognizes me so I can not access any of the app. After paying for a years subscription I am super frustrated. There should at least be an option to reset a password. However it was never needed before. I purchased in January and loved it until now.

reviews.title: A once great app — DO NOT DOWNLOAD
reviews.text: The acquisition of Breathwrk destroyed what was once an indispensable app. I went through a month long dispute that I eventually had chargeback with American Express. Tried repeatedly to cancel with Breathwrk and got radio silence. Tried to cancel with Pelaton but they couldn’t locate my account since it was only with Breathwrk, this despite the billing invoice coming from Pelaton. Just a total mess. Finally got it worked out after Amex got involved and I filed an Attorney General complaint.

reviews.title: Needs watch support
reviews.text: I’m a daily peloton meditation user, and was excited about the app. Love the guided breathing, but it feels like a huge miss to not have heart rate tracking via Apple Watch. I’ll stick with the flagship peloton meditation until the Breathwrk app gets watch support.

reviews.title: I’ve had so many problems with this app, every upgrade it looses your place.
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app every single day since April 26 2025 and since today when they upgraded my app I can’t even get into it to use it and I’m sure that all my days have been lost. This has a huge disappointment. This better be fixed. I’ve had so many problems and no one even reaches out to make it right.

reviews.title: Loved it. Not Now
reviews.text:
I’ve used and recommended the app for years. 
Since they joined Peloton, things apparently changed. I’m locked out and now have to delete the app!  Sad.

reviews.title: I wish I could find an alternative
reviews.text: This app would be great if it worked all the time. I’ve had so many issues it’s crazy. Multiple times I’ve had 100-300 day streaks that have just erased for no apparent reason. It barely works half the time, haphazard sounds or no haptics or sounds even when they are selected. I can’t believe they haven’t worked out the same bugs it’s had for years. It doesn’t seem like a complicated app to have work consistently

reviews.title: Can’t manage subscription
reviews.text: I got this subscription as part of a promotion before Peloton acquired it. The website for customer support doesn’t work or doesn’t exist anymore when you follow the FAQ. I did love the app for what it offered but I had to dispute the charge with my credit card because I couldn’t get ahold of anyone to manage my subscription. Peloton just sent me to the nonworking websites and emails so they were no help. I’d like to think such a large company wouldn’t like to be associated with an app that is bordering on fraudulent.

reviews.title: Update caused voice prompts to not work
reviews.text: No response from support. Don’t recommend. Update caused voice prompts to not work

reviews.title: Great app, but recent bugs are frustrating
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app consistently and it’s been really helpful for relaxation and breathwork, but lately it’s been getting buggy. The timer sometimes goes off even when there’s still time left, and the voice guidance randomly stops working. Also, when I close my phone, the soundscape cuts out but I can still hear the tone, which is confusing and breaks the experience.

I really like the app overall, but these issues started happening this week and make it harder to rely on. Hoping for a quick fix because it’s a great tool when it works properly.

reviews.title: Terrible start to my trial
reviews.text: I downloaded the app yesterday and optimistically signed up for the 7 day trail + annual subscription. Too bad it won’t permit me to sign in with my google account. I get a “one minute please” message and then it just stops after a bit. What a disappointment.

reviews.title: Great, but very glitchy
reviews.text:
Been a consistent user of this app for 5 years. I’ve recommended it to friends and family.
But when peloton bought it, it started glitching and never recovered… 
Unfortunately, the streak hardly works. I do more than 5 min/day (required amount to keep a streak), yet my “streak” is has never hit more than 6 days. Most of the time, streak resets daily.
And today, it just stopped giving Inhale Hold Exhale verbal cues. Even though Max’s voice was selected for cues, nada.

Idk, my love for this app is waning. It seems like the devs have given up.

reviews.title: Annoying programming
reviews.text:
Halfway into your session you will start to hear annoying clicks. Pretty off putting when you are trying to meditate.  Now on every inhale I hear the congratulatory sound they play when a session is over. 

I’ve contacted support to report this but only got a generic AI response that ignored my message completely. Otherwise this would have been a great app. Hopefully they will fix it with the next update.

reviews.title: Can’t customize what matters
reviews.text: The last update to the App added a 1 min left chime that is the SAME AS THE END CHIME. Who the hell wants that? Who wants to be interrupted thinking they’re done? AND THERES NOTHING YOU CAN DO ABOUT IT. THERE IS NO ABILITY TO TURN IT OFF.

reviews.title: 5 years of Breathwrk
reviews.text: I’ve been using the app for 5 years and I say the first 2 years were the best time to use it. Way more options better ui didn’t bombard you trying to make you buy the plan. I miss it
